title: Do I even need a visa? 86 countries don't.
title_cn: 我需要签证吗？86 个国家不需要
pain: Uncertain which visa type applies and how long it takes.
pain_cn: 不确定适用哪种签证类型，也不清楚需要多长时间。
solution: 86 countries enter visa-free for 30 days (tourism, business, family, medical, exhibitions, sports). For work use Z, study X1/X2, family Q1/Q2.
solution_cn: 86 国人员免签入境 30 天（旅游/商务/探亲/医疗/会展/体育）。工作用 Z 签，学习用 X1/X2，家庭团聚用 Q1/Q2。

source.name: Hainan FTP International Service Portal
source.name_cn: 海南自贸港国际服务门户

title: The Z-visa document checklist, decoded.
title_cn: Z 字签证材料清单，逐条拆解
pain: Application materials feel complicated and unclear.
pain_cn: 申请材料繁琐、要求不清晰。
solution: One-window service: work permit + residence permit together. We give you a standardised checklist and track progress.
solution_cn: 「一窗通办」：工作许可与居留许可一起办。我们提供标准化清单并全程跟踪进度。

title: Where do I stay before I find 'home'?
title_cn: 在找到「家」之前，我住哪里？
pain: Hard to find short/long-term housing suited to foreigners from abroad.
pain_cn: 人在境外，很难找到适合外国人的短期/长期住房。
solution: 'Arrival Package': airport pickup, transitional housing at partner hotels/apartments, initial essentials setup.
solution_cn: 「安心抵达套餐」：接机、合作酒店/公寓过渡住宿、初期生活用品配置。

source.name: en.hainan.gov.cn — Living services
source.name_cn: 海南政府网 — 生活服务

title: Pre-load e-CNY before you even land.
title_cn: 落地前就预充值数字人民币
pain: Worried about paying on arrival; unsure how to exchange money or open accounts.
pain_cn: 担心抵达时无法支付；不确定如何兑换货币或开户。
solution: Pre-charge a digital-yuan (e-CNY) wallet from abroad — 210+ countries register by phone, anonymous wallet, no Chinese bank card needed.
solution_cn: 从境外预充值数字人民币钱包——支持 210+ 国家手机号注册、匿名钱包、无需境内银行卡。

source.name: PBOC — e-CNY for inbound visitors
source.name_cn: 人民银行 — 入境旅客数字人民币

title: Visa, Mastercard, JCB — now work on WeChat & Alipay.
pain: Fear that only Chinese bank cards are accepted.
pain_cn: 担心只接受中国银行卡。
solution: WeChat Pay & Alipay accept Visa / Mastercard / JCB / Amex / Discover. Foreign phone numbers supported.
solution_cn: 微信支付与支付宝支持 Visa/Mastercard/JCB/Amex/Discover，并支持境外手机号。

source.name: PBOC — Payment Guide for Foreigners
source.name_cn: 人民银行 — 外籍来华支付指南

title: The language barrier starts before takeoff.
title_cn: 语言障碍，从起飞前就开始了
pain: Worried about communicating in Chinese upon arrival.
pain_cn: 担心抵达后无法用中文沟通。
solution: 12345 hotline serves EN / RU / JA / KO; bilingual signage is mandated at airports and transport hubs.
solution_cn: 12345 热线提供英/俄/日/韩服务；机场及交通枢纽强制设置双语标识。

title: Three airports, direct from everywhere.
pain: Unfamiliar with entry ports and transport.
pain_cn: 不熟悉入境口岸和交通方式。
solution: Haikou Meilan, Sanya Phoenix, Bo'ao airports — plus 144-hour transit via HK/Macau and 15-day cruise access.
solution_cn: 海口美兰、三亚凤凰、博鳌机场——另有经港/澳 144 小时过境免签及 15 天邮轮免签。

title: Medicines & vaccinations: pack smart before you fly
title_cn: 药品与疫苗：起飞前聪明打包
pain: Unsure which medicines you can bring into China, and whether you need vaccinations or health documents.
pain_cn: 不确定哪些药品能带入中国，是否需要疫苗或健康证明。
solution: Ouwen's pre-trip health checklist: carry a doctor's note + prescription for personal meds, declare controlled items at customs, and confirm which vaccinations are recommended for your itinerary.
solution_cn: 欧闻行前健康清单：个人药品携带医生证明 + 处方、受控物品在海关申报、确认行程推荐疫苗。

title: Cash & customs: what you must declare when entering Hainan
title_cn: 现金与海关：入境海南必须申报什么
pain: Foreigners don't know the cash limits and which items must be declared at Chinese customs, risking fines or confiscation.
pain_cn: 外籍人士不清楚入境现金限额和哪些物品必须向海关申报，有被罚款或没收的风险。
solution: Ouwen's pre-flight customs checklist: declare RMB cash of ¥20,000+ or foreign currency of USD 5,000+, and know the red/green channel rules before you board.
solution_cn: 欧闻行前海关清单：人民币现金 ≥2 万或外币 ≥5000 美元须主动申报，并提前搞清红绿通道规则。

title: Bringing your pet to Hainan? Start the paperwork 30+ days early.
title_cn: 带宠物来海南？至少提前 30 天备材料
pain: Foreigners relocating with a dog or cat don't realize China requires an ISO microchip, an up-to-date rabies vaccine, and an official health certificate, plus entry through a designated port — or their pet gets quarantined.
pain_cn: 带猫狗来琼的外籍人士不知道中国要求 ISO 芯片、有效狂犬疫苗和官方健康证明，且须从指定口岸入境——否则宠物会被隔离。
solution: Ouwen's pet-arrival checklist maps every requirement by origin country, tells you which ports accept pets, and prepares the full certificate pack before you fly.
solution_cn: 欧闻宠物入境清单按来源国逐项列出要求、告知哪些口岸可携宠入境，并在起飞前备齐全套证明。

title: Book smart: the new flight-tax refund most visitors miss.
title_cn: 聪明购票：大多数访客不知道的国际航班离境退税
pain: Foreign travellers don't know they can claim back value-added tax on plane tickets purchased in China — and that Hainan has its own additional refund scheme for island-bound flights.
pain_cn: 外籍旅客不知道可以申请中国境内购买的机票增值税退税，也不知道海南还有针对离岛航班的地方退税政策。
solution: Ouwen walks you through the CNY 100k VAT-refund cap for international flights, Hainan's island-departure tax-refund eligibility, and which airlines participate.
solution_cn: 欧闻带你了解国际航班最高 10 万元增值税退税额度、海南离岛退税条件，以及参与航司名单。

title: Fill out your China entry health declaration before you board
title_cn: 登机前填好中国入境健康申报
pain: Many travellers arrive at the Hainan border without completing China's mandatory entry health declaration, causing delays at the checkpoint or being pulled aside to fill it out on the spot.
pain_cn: 不少旅客抵达海南口岸才发现没填中国入境健康申报，在边检排队或被要求现场补填。
solution: Ouwen's pre-flight checklist shows you how to complete the health declaration via the 'Customs Pocket Declaration' WeChat mini-program (or paper form), save the QR code, and present it on arrival.
solution_cn: 欧闻行前清单教你通过「海关旅客指尖服务」微信小程序（或纸质版）完成健康申报、保存二维码并在入境时出示。
